title: Anti-Ragging Committee
body:
## Anti-Ragging Committee

Government Polytechnic College, Kannur maintains a **zero-tolerance policy** towards ragging in any form.

### Committee Members

| Sl. No. | Name | Designation | Role |
|---------|------|-------------|------|
| 1 | Principal | Chairperson | Overall supervision |
| 2 | Head of Department | Member | Department-level monitoring |
| 3 | Senior Faculty | Member | Student counseling |

### Helpline

- **National Anti-Ragging Helpline**: 1800-180-5522
- **UGC Website**: [antiragging.in](https://antiragging.in)

### How to Report

Students can report ragging incidents through:
1. Direct complaint to the Anti-Ragging Committee
2. Online complaint at [antiragging.in](https://antiragging.in)
3. Calling the helpline number

> Any student found guilty of ragging shall be liable for strict disciplinary action as per AICTE/UGC regulations.
